SELECT loan_id, as_of_date
FROM main.risk_classification
WHERE grade_code = 'SUBSTANDARD'
ORDER BY loan_id ASC;

SELECT p.payment_id, p.business_date, p.amount
FROM payment_event p
JOIN payment_type_catalog ptc ON p.payment_type = ptc.payment_type
WHERE ptc.name_zh = '现金支取'
  AND p.amount > 5000000
ORDER BY p.amount DESC;

SELECT pp.party_id, pp.annual_income
FROM person_profile pp
WHERE pp.annual_income > 1000000
ORDER BY pp.annual_income DESC;

SELECT c.card_id, c.issued_on, c.expires_on
FROM payment_card c
JOIN card_type_catalog ct ON c.card_type = ct.card_type
WHERE ct.name_zh = '贷记卡'
ORDER BY c.issued_on ASC;

SELECT 
    p.party_id AS 客户编号,
    p.display_name AS 客户名称,
    o.operating_status AS 经营状态
FROM main.party p
JOIN main.organization_profile o ON p.party_id = o.party_id
JOIN main.organization_unit ou ON p.home_org_unit_id = ou.org_unit_id
WHERE ou.region_code = (
    SELECT region_code 
    FROM main.organization_unit 
    WHERE unit_name = '上海分行' 
    LIMIT 1
)
ORDER BY p.party_id ASC;

SELECT i.institution_name, COUNT(ld.loan_id) AS loan_count
FROM institution i
LEFT JOIN credit_agreement ca ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
LEFT JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY loan_count DESC;

SELECT ou.org_unit_id, ou.unit_name, COUNT(a.account_id) AS account_count
FROM organization_unit ou
LEFT JOIN account a ON ou.org_unit_id = a.org_unit_id
GROUP BY ou.org_unit_id, ou.unit_name
ORDER BY account_count DESC;

SELECT 
    i.sector_name_zh AS 行业中文名称,
    SUM(ca.contract_amount) AS 合同金额合计
FROM main.credit_agreement ca
JOIN main.organization_profile op ON ca.borrower_party_id = op.party_id
JOIN main.industry_sector i ON op.industry_code = i.sector_code
GROUP BY i.sector_name_zh
ORDER BY 合同金额合计 DESC;

SELECT wp.product_name,
       SUM(phs.converted_amount) AS total_holding_value
FROM wealth_product wp
JOIN product_holding_snapshot phs ON wp.product_id = phs.product_id
GROUP BY wp.product_id, wp.product_name
ORDER BY total_holding_value DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT ou.org_unit_id,
       ou.unit_name,
       COUNT(pr.relation_id) AS relation_count
FROM party_relation pr
JOIN party p ON pr.source_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN organization_unit ou ON p.home_org_unit_id = ou.org_unit_id
GROUP BY ou.org_unit_id, ou.unit_name
ORDER BY relation_count DESC;

SELECT i.institution_name,
       cs.net_capital,
       cs.risk_weighted_assets
FROM institution i
JOIN capital_snapshot cs ON i.institution_id = cs.institution_id
ORDER BY cs.net_capital DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    SUM(ab.ledger_balance) AS total_deposit_balance
FROM account a
JOIN institution i ON a.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN account_balance_snapshot ab ON a.account_id = ab.account_id
WHERE a.account_kind = 'SAVINGS'
  AND a.status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND ab.as_of_date = (
      SELECT MAX(as_of_date) 
      FROM account_balance_snapshot 
      WHERE account_id = a.account_id
  )
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY total_deposit_balance DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    AVG(d.principal_overdue_days) AS avg_overdue_days
FROM main.institution i
JOIN main.organization_unit ou ON i.institution_id = ou.institution_id
JOIN main.account a ON ou.org_unit_id = a.org_unit_id
JOIN main.loan_drawdown ld ON a.account_id = ld.loan_account_id
JOIN main.delinquency_snapshot d ON ld.loan_id = d.loan_id
WHERE d.principal_overdue_days > 0
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING AVG(d.principal_overdue_days) > 90
ORDER BY avg_overdue_days DESC;

SELECT 
    eg.exposure_group_id AS 集团编号,
    eg.group_name AS 集团名称,
    COALESCE(SUM(ld.disbursed_amount), 0) AS 敞口金额,
    ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(ld.disbursed_amount), 0) * 1.0 / NULLIF(cs.net_capital, 0), 4) AS 敞口占资本净额比重
FROM exposure_group eg
LEFT JOIN exposure_group_member egm ON eg.exposure_group_id = egm.exposure_group_id
LEFT JOIN party p ON egm.party_id = p.party_id
LEFT JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
LEFT JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
LEFT JOIN capital_snapshot cs ON cs.institution_id = eg.institution_id
    AND cs.as_of_date = (
        SELECT MAX(as_of_date) FROM capital_snapshot 
        WHERE institution_id = eg.institution_id
    )
WHERE egm.effective_to IS NULL
GROUP BY eg.exposure_group_id, eg.group_name, cs.net_capital
ORDER BY 敞口占资本净额比重 DESC;

SELECT 
    isc.sector_name_zh AS 行业名称,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ca.agreement_id) AS 贷款笔数,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN rc.grade_code IN ('次级', '可疑', '损失') THEN ca.agreement_id END) AS 不良笔数,
    ROUND(1.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN rc.grade_code IN ('次级', '可疑', '损失') THEN ca.agreement_id END) / COUNT(DISTINCT ca.agreement_id), 4) AS 不良笔数占比
FROM credit_agreement ca
JOIN organization_profile op ON ca.borrower_party_id = op.party_id
JOIN industry_sector isc ON op.industry_code = isc.sector_code
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN risk_classification rc ON ld.loan_id = rc.loan_id
WHERE rc.as_of_date = (
    SELECT MAX(rc2.as_of_date) 
    FROM risk_classification rc2 
    WHERE rc2.loan_id = rc.loan_id
)
GROUP BY isc.sector_code, isc.sector_name_zh
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ca.agreement_id) >= 20
ORDER BY 不良笔数占比 DESC;

SELECT 
    p.party_id AS 客户编号,
    p.display_name AS 客户名称,
    SUM(ca.contract_amount) AS 合同金额合计
FROM party p
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON p.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name
ORDER BY 合同金额合计 DESC
LIMIT 15;

SELECT risk_level, COUNT(*) AS product_count, AVG(management_fee_rate) AS avg_management_fee_rate
FROM wealth_product
GROUP BY risk_level
ORDER BY risk_level ASC;

SELECT 
    g.guarantor_party_id AS 担保人编号,
    p.display_name AS 担保人名称,
    SUM(g.guaranteed_amount) AS 在保余额合计
FROM main.guarantor_commitment g
JOIN main.party p ON g.guarantor_party_id = p.party_id
WHERE g.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY g.guarantor_party_id, p.display_name
HAVING SUM(g.guaranteed_amount) > 500000000
ORDER BY 在保余额合计 DESC;

SELECT
    p.party_id AS 客户编号,
    p.display_name AS 客户名称,
    SUM(ca.contract_amount) AS 合同金额合计
FROM party_relation pr
JOIN party p ON pr.source_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
WHERE pr.relation_type != '非关联方'
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name
HAVING SUM(ca.contract_amount) > 300000000
ORDER BY SUM(ca.contract_amount) DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(ds.record_id) AS record_count,
    SUM(ds.observed_value) AS total_observed_value
FROM data_security_event_v3 ds
JOIN institution i ON ds.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE ds.exception_flag = 1
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY total_observed_value DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(*) AS overdue_count
FROM regulatory_submission_event_v3 r
JOIN institution i ON r.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE (r.completion_date IS NULL OR r.completion_date > r.deadline_date)
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 20
ORDER BY overdue_count DESC;

SELECT i.institution_name,
       cs.net_capital * 1.0 / cs.risk_weighted_assets AS capital_adequacy_ratio
FROM capital_snapshot cs
JOIN institution i ON cs.institution_id = i.institution_id
ORDER BY capital_adequacy_ratio ASC;

SELECT 
    ld.loan_id AS 借据编号,
    ds.principal_overdue_days AS 逾期天数,
    cg.grade_name_zh AS 分类名称,
    rc.as_of_date AS 分类日期
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN delinquency_snapshot ds ON ld.loan_id = ds.loan_id
JOIN risk_classification rc ON ld.loan_id = rc.loan_id
JOIN classification_grade cg ON rc.grade_code = cg.grade_code
WHERE ds.principal_overdue_days > 90
  AND cg.grade_name_zh IN ('正常', '关注')
  AND rc.as_of_date = (
      SELECT MAX(rc2.as_of_date)
      FROM risk_classification rc2
      WHERE rc2.loan_id = ld.loan_id
  )
ORDER BY ds.principal_overdue_days DESC;

SELECT i.institution_name,
       SUM(lbs.principal_balance) AS insufficient_provision_loan_balance
FROM institution i
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
JOIN provision_snapshot ps ON ld.loan_id = ps.loan_id
WHERE ps.required_amount > ps.recognized_amount
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING SUM(lbs.principal_balance) > 100000000
ORDER BY insufficient_provision_loan_balance DESC;

SELECT 
    pi.instruction_id,
    pi.loan_id,
    p.display_name AS payee_name,
    ind.sector_name_zh AS industry_name,
    pi.instruction_amount
FROM payment_instruction pi
JOIN party p ON pi.intended_payee_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN organization_profile op ON p.party_id = op.party_id
JOIN industry_sector ind ON op.industry_code = ind.sector_code
WHERE pi.status = 'EXECUTED'
  AND ind.risk_category IN ('RESTRICTED', 'EXIT')
ORDER BY pi.instruction_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    SUM(CASE 
        WHEN op.industry_code IN (
            SELECT sector_code FROM industry_sector 
            WHERE risk_category IN ('限制类', '退出类')
        ) THEN pi.instruction_amount 
        ELSE 0 
    END) AS 违规流入金额,
    SUM(pi.instruction_amount) AS 指令金额合计,
    ROUND(
        1.0 * SUM(CASE 
            WHEN op.industry_code IN (
                SELECT sector_code FROM industry_sector 
                WHERE risk_category IN ('限制类', '退出类')
            ) THEN pi.instruction_amount 
            ELSE 0 
        END) / NULLIF(SUM(pi.instruction_amount), 0),
        4
    ) AS 占比
FROM payment_instruction pi
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON pi.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
LEFT JOIN organization_profile op ON ca.borrower_party_id = op.party_id
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY 占比 DESC;

SELECT 
    wp.product_id,
    wp.product_name,
    ma.asset_id,
    ma.maturity_on AS asset_maturity_on,
    wp.actual_termination_on AS product_termination_on
FROM wealth_product wp
JOIN product_holding_snapshot phs ON wp.product_id = phs.product_id
JOIN managed_asset ma ON phs.asset_id = ma.asset_id
WHERE ma.maturity_on > wp.actual_termination_on
ORDER BY ma.maturity_on DESC;

SELECT 
    p.party_id,
    p.display_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT gc.commitment_id) AS guarantee_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ca.agreement_id) AS borrower_count
FROM party p
LEFT JOIN guarantor_commitment gc ON gc.guarantor_party_id = p.party_id
LEFT JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
WHERE gc.commitment_id IS NOT NULL AND ca.agreement_id IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name
ORDER BY guarantee_count DESC;

SELECT 
    pe.payment_id AS 交易编号,
    pe.business_date AS 业务日期,
    ptc.name_zh AS 交易类型中文名称,
    pe.amount AS 金额,
    ou.unit_name AS 经办机构单元名称
FROM main.payment_event pe
JOIN main.payment_type_catalog ptc ON pe.payment_type = ptc.payment_type
JOIN main.organization_unit ou ON pe.origin_org_unit_id = ou.org_unit_id
WHERE pe.is_cash = 1
  AND pe.amount > 5000000
  AND pe.status = 'SETTLED'
ORDER BY pe.amount DESC;

SELECT 
    ca.agreement_id AS 协议编号,
    p.display_name AS 借款人名称,
    op.industry_code AS 借款人注册行业代码,
    ca.target_industry_code AS 协议投向行业代码,
    ca.contract_amount AS 合同金额
FROM credit_agreement ca
JOIN party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
LEFT JOIN organization_profile op ON p.party_id = op.party_id
WHERE ca.target_industry_code IS NOT NULL
  AND op.industry_code IS NOT NULL
  AND ca.target_industry_code <> op.industry_code
ORDER BY ca.contract_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    pe.payment_id AS 交易编号,
    pe.business_date AS 业务日期,
    pe.amount AS 金额,
    ah_from.party_id AS 付款方客户编号,
    ah_to.party_id AS 收款方客户编号
FROM payment_event pe
JOIN account_holder ah_from 
    ON pe.from_account_id = ah_from.account_id
    AND ah_from.holder_role = 'PRIMARY'
    AND ah_from.effective_to IS NULL
JOIN account_holder ah_to 
    ON pe.to_account_id = ah_to.account_id
    AND ah_to.holder_role = 'PRIMARY'
    AND ah_to.effective_to IS NULL
JOIN party_relation pr 
    ON pr.source_party_id = ah_from.party_id
    AND pr.target_party_id = ah_to.party_id
    AND pr.relation_type <> 'NON_RELATED'
    AND pr.effective_to IS NULL
WHERE pe.status = 'SETTLED'
ORDER BY pe.amount DESC;

SELECT 
    ca.agreement_id AS 协议编号,
    p.display_name AS 借款人名称,
    COUNT(ld.loan_id) AS 借据笔数
FROM credit_agreement ca
JOIN party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
GROUP BY ca.agreement_id, p.display_name
HAVING COUNT(ld.loan_id) >= 3
ORDER BY COUNT(ld.loan_id) DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(*) AS transaction_count,
    SUM(p.amount) AS total_amount
FROM payment_event p
JOIN account a ON p.from_account_id = a.account_id
JOIN institution i ON a.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE p.is_cash = 1
  AND p.amount > 5000000
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 50
ORDER BY total_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    sm.staff_id AS 员工工号,
    COUNT(pe.payment_id) AS 交易笔数
FROM staff_member sm
JOIN staff_assignment sa ON sm.staff_id = sa.staff_id
JOIN service_operator so ON sm.staff_id = so.staff_id
JOIN payment_event pe ON so.operator_id = pe.operator_id
JOIN account_holder ah ON pe.to_account_id = ah.account_id
JOIN party p ON ah.party_id = p.party_id
JOIN organization_profile op ON p.party_id = op.party_id
JOIN industry_sector ind ON op.industry_code = ind.sector_code
WHERE sa.role_title = '客户经理'
  AND ind.risk_category IN ('RESTRICTED', 'EXIT')
  AND pe.status = 'SETTLED'
GROUP BY sm.staff_id
ORDER BY 交易笔数 DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT 
    cddv3.record_id,
    i.institution_name,
    cddv3.event_date,
    cddv3.deadline_date,
    CAST(julianday('2026-06-30') - julianday(cddv3.deadline_date) AS INTEGER) AS days_diff
FROM customer_due_diligence_event_v3 cddv3
JOIN institution i ON cddv3.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE cddv3.completion_date IS NULL
  AND cddv3.deadline_date IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY days_diff DESC
LIMIT 20;

SELECT 
    sa.security_id AS 担保合同编号,
    cl.collateral_id AS 抵押物编号,
    ca.status AS 抵押物状态,
    sa.status AS 担保合同状态
FROM security_agreement sa
JOIN collateral_link cl ON sa.security_id = cl.security_id
JOIN collateral_asset ca ON cl.collateral_id = ca.collateral_id
WHERE ca.status = 'RELEASED'
  AND sa.status = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY sa.security_id ASC;

SELECT 
    ld.loan_id AS 借据编号,
    ld.agreement_id AS 协议编号,
    sa.security_id AS 担保合同编号,
    sa.secured_amount AS 担保债权金额
FROM main.loan_drawdown ld
JOIN main.credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN main.secured_obligation so ON ca.agreement_id = so.agreement_id
JOIN main.security_agreement sa ON so.security_id = sa.security_id
WHERE ld.status = 'WRITTEN_OFF'
  AND sa.status = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY sa.secured_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    ld.loan_id,
    lbs.principal_balance,
    rn AS balance_rank
FROM (
    SELECT 
        ld.institution_id,
        ld.loan_id,
        lbs.principal_balance,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY ld.institution_id 
            ORDER BY lbs.principal_balance DESC, ld.loan_id ASC
        ) AS rn
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
) ranked
JOIN institution i ON ranked.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE ranked.rn = 1
ORDER BY i.institution_name ASC;

SELECT 
    is2.sector_name_zh AS 行业中文名称,
    ld.loan_id AS 借据编号,
    lbs.principal_balance AS 本金余额,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY op.industry_code ORDER BY lbs.principal_balance DESC) AS 排名
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN organization_profile op ON ca.borrower_party_id = op.party_id
JOIN industry_sector is2 ON op.industry_code = is2.sector_code
JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
WHERE lbs.as_of_date = (SELECT MAX(as_of_date) FROM loan_balance_snapshot)
  AND op.industry_code IS NOT NULL
  AND lbs.principal_balance IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY 行业中文名称 ASC, 排名 ASC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT 
    business_date,
    COUNT(*) AS daily_count,
    COUNT(*) - LAG(COUNT(*)) OVER (ORDER BY business_date) AS change_from_previous
FROM payment_event
GROUP BY business_date
ORDER BY business_date ASC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    ld.loan_id,
    lbs.principal_balance,
    avg_bal.avg_principal_balance,
    lbs.principal_balance - avg_bal.avg_principal_balance AS excess_amount
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
JOIN (
    SELECT 
        ca.institution_id,
        AVG(lbs2.principal_balance) AS avg_principal_balance
    FROM loan_drawdown ld2
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld2.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs2 ON ld2.loan_id = lbs2.loan_id
    GROUP BY ca.institution_id
) avg_bal ON ca.institution_id = avg_bal.institution_id
WHERE lbs.principal_balance > avg_bal.avg_principal_balance
ORDER BY excess_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    sa.security_id AS 担保合同编号,
    sa.secured_amount AS 担保债权金额,
    COUNT(DISTINCT gc.guarantor_party_id) AS 担保人数量
FROM main.security_agreement sa
LEFT JOIN main.collateral_link cl ON sa.security_id = cl.security_id
LEFT JOIN main.guarantor_commitment gc ON sa.security_id = gc.security_id
WHERE sa.security_type = 'GUARANTEE'
  AND cl.collateral_id IS NULL
GROUP BY sa.security_id, sa.secured_amount
ORDER BY sa.secured_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN principal_overdue_days = 0 THEN '未逾期'
        WHEN principal_overdue_days BETWEEN 1 AND 30 THEN '1-30天'
        WHEN principal_overdue_days BETWEEN 31 AND 90 THEN '31-90天'
        WHEN principal_overdue_days BETWEEN 91 AND 180 THEN '91-180天'
        WHEN principal_overdue_days BETWEEN 181 AND 360 THEN '181-360天'
        ELSE '360天以上'
    END AS overdue_interval,
    COUNT(*) AS loan_count
FROM delinquency_snapshot
GROUP BY overdue_interval
ORDER BY MIN(principal_overdue_days);

SELECT 
    collateral_id, 
    valued_on, 
    COUNT(*) AS duplicate_count
FROM collateral_valuation
GROUP BY collateral_id, valued_on
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
ORDER BY collateral_id ASC;

SELECT 
    ca.borrower_party_id AS customer_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ld.loan_id) AS loan_count,
    SUM(lbs.principal_balance) AS total_principal_balance,
    AVG(lbs.principal_balance) AS avg_loan_amount
FROM main.credit_agreement ca
JOIN main.loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN main.loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
WHERE ca.borrower_party_id LIKE 'PTY-C%'
GROUP BY ca.borrower_party_id
ORDER BY avg_loan_amount DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT 
    ou.unit_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT sm.staff_id) AS staff_count,
    COUNT(pe.payment_id) AS transaction_count
FROM organization_unit ou
LEFT JOIN staff_member sm ON sm.home_org_unit_id = ou.org_unit_id
LEFT JOIN service_operator so ON so.staff_id = sm.staff_id
LEFT JOIN payment_event pe ON pe.operator_id = so.operator_id AND pe.is_cash = 1
GROUP BY ou.org_unit_id, ou.unit_name
ORDER BY transaction_count DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT 
  customer_segment,
  COUNT(*) AS customer_count,
  AVG(annual_income) AS avg_annual_income,
  SUM(CASE WHEN annual_income > 1000000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS high_income_ratio
FROM main.party p
JOIN main.person_profile pp ON p.party_id = pp.party_id
WHERE p.party_type = 'INDIVIDUAL'
GROUP BY customer_segment
ORDER BY customer_segment ASC;

SELECT
    inst.institution_name,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN related.relation_id IS NOT NULL THEN p.amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS related_txn_amount,
    COALESCE(SUM(p.amount), 0) AS total_txn_amount,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN related.relation_id IS NOT NULL THEN p.amount ELSE 0 END), 0) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(p.amount), 0) AS related_ratio
FROM payment_event p
LEFT JOIN account from_acc ON p.from_account_id = from_acc.account_id
LEFT JOIN account to_acc ON p.to_account_id = to_acc.account_id
LEFT JOIN institution inst ON inst.institution_id = COALESCE(from_acc.institution_id, to_acc.institution_id)
LEFT JOIN account_holder from_holder ON from_holder.account_id = p.from_account_id AND from_holder.holder_role = 'PRIMARY'
LEFT JOIN account_holder to_holder ON to_holder.account_id = p.to_account_id AND to_holder.holder_role = 'PRIMARY'
LEFT JOIN party_relation related ON related.source_party_id = from_holder.party_id
    AND related.target_party_id = to_holder.party_id
    AND related.relation_type <> 'NON_RELATED'
WHERE p.status = 'SETTLED'
GROUP BY inst.institution_id, inst.institution_name
ORDER BY related_ratio DESC;

SELECT 
    p.party_id AS 客户编号,
    p.display_name AS 客户名称,
    COUNT(DISTINCT pc.card_id) AS 持有贷记卡数量,
    COUNT(DISTINCT td.account_id) AS 定期存款账户数量
FROM party p
JOIN payment_card pc ON pc.holder_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN card_type_catalog ctc ON ctc.card_type = pc.card_type
JOIN term_deposit td ON td.account_id IN (
    SELECT account_id FROM account_holder WHERE party_id = p.party_id
)
WHERE p.party_type = 'INDIVIDUAL'
  AND ctc.card_type = 'CREDIT'
  AND pc.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT pc.card_id) > 0 AND COUNT(DISTINCT td.account_id) > 0
ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT td.account_id) DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    AVG(julianday('2026-06-30') - julianday(ld.disbursed_on)) AS avg_loan_age_days
FROM institution i
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY avg_loan_age_days DESC;

SELECT 
    loan_id,
    principal_balance,
    quartile_group
FROM (
    SELECT 
        loan_id,
        principal_balance,
        NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY principal_balance DESC) AS quartile_group
    FROM main.loan_balance_snapshot
) AS quartiled
ORDER BY 
    quartile_group ASC,
    principal_balance DESC,
    loan_id ASC
LIMIT 40;

WITH industry_balances AS (
    SELECT 
        org.industry_code,
        org.industry_name,
        SUM(COALESCE(lbs.principal_balance, 0)) AS total_balance
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            op.party_id,
            op.industry_code,
            isec.sector_name_zh AS industry_name
        FROM organization_profile op
        LEFT JOIN industry_sector isec ON op.industry_code = isec.sector_code
        WHERE op.industry_code IS NOT NULL
    ) org
    LEFT JOIN credit_agreement ca ON org.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
    LEFT JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
    LEFT JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
    GROUP BY org.industry_code, org.industry_name
),
total_balance AS (
    SELECT SUM(total_balance) AS grand_total
    FROM industry_balances
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT 
        industry_name,
        total_balance,
        SUM(total_balance) OVER (ORDER BY total_balance DESC) AS running_total,
        total_balance * 1.0 / (SELECT grand_total FROM total_balance) AS balance_ratio
    FROM industry_balances
),
cumulative AS (
    SELECT 
        industry_name,
        total_balance,
        balance_ratio,
        SUM(balance_ratio) OVER (ORDER BY total_balance DESC) AS cumulative_ratio
    FROM ranked
)
SELECT 
    industry_name,
    total_balance,
    cumulative_ratio
FROM cumulative
WHERE cumulative_ratio <= 0.8
ORDER BY cumulative_ratio ASC;

SELECT 
    p.party_id AS 客户编号,
    p.display_name AS 客户名称,
    i.institution_name AS 机构名称,
    COUNT(ld.loan_id) AS 未结清借据笔数
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
WHERE ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name, i.institution_name
HAVING COUNT(ld.loan_id) >= 2
ORDER BY COUNT(ld.loan_id) DESC;

SELECT 
    sa.security_id,
    sa.secured_amount,
    ca.collateral_id,
    cv.latest_valuation
FROM security_agreement sa
JOIN secured_obligation so ON sa.security_id = so.security_id
JOIN collateral_link cl ON sa.security_id = cl.security_id
JOIN collateral_asset ca ON cl.collateral_id = ca.collateral_id
JOIN (
    SELECT collateral_id, valuation_amount AS latest_valuation
    FROM collateral_valuation cv1
    WHERE valued_on = (
        SELECT MAX(valued_on)
        FROM collateral_valuation cv2
        WHERE cv2.collateral_id = cv1.collateral_id
    )
) cv ON ca.collateral_id = cv.collateral_id
WHERE cv.latest_valuation > sa.secured_amount * 2
ORDER BY (cv.latest_valuation - sa.secured_amount) DESC;

SELECT 
    p.party_id AS 客户编号,
    p.display_name AS 客户名称,
    COUNT(DISTINCT a.institution_id) AS 开户机构家数
FROM main.party p
JOIN main.account_holder ah ON p.party_id = ah.party_id
JOIN main.account a ON ah.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE p.party_type = 'INDIVIDUAL'
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.institution_id) > 1
ORDER BY 开户机构家数 DESC;

SELECT 
    from_account_id AS account_id,
    business_date AS transaction_date,
    COUNT(*) AS transaction_count
FROM payment_event
WHERE from_account_id IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY from_account_id, business_date
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3
ORDER BY transaction_count DESC
LIMIT 20;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) AS member_count,
    COALESCE(SUM(lbs.principal_balance), 0) AS total_principal_balance
FROM institution i
LEFT JOIN exposure_group eg ON i.institution_id = eg.institution_id
LEFT JOIN exposure_group_member egm ON eg.exposure_group_id = egm.exposure_group_id
LEFT JOIN account_holder ah ON egm.party_id = ah.party_id
LEFT JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ah.account_id = ld.loan_account_id
LEFT JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY total_principal_balance DESC;

SELECT 
    g.guarantor_party_id,
    p.display_name AS guarantor_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT g.security_id) AS guarantee_contract_count,
    SUM(g.guaranteed_amount) AS total_guaranteed_amount
FROM guarantor_commitment g
JOIN party p ON g.guarantor_party_id = p.party_id
GROUP BY g.guarantor_party_id, p.display_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT g.security_id) > 1
   AND SUM(g.guaranteed_amount) > 300000000
ORDER BY total_guaranteed_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(ld.loan_id) AS loan_count
FROM main.loan_drawdown ld
JOIN main.institution i ON ld.agreement_id IN (
    SELECT ca.agreement_id 
    FROM main.credit_agreement ca 
    WHERE ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
)
WHERE ld.payment_mode = 'ENTRUSTED_PAYMENT'
  AND ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY i.institution_name
ORDER BY loan_count DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT dl.loan_id) AS loan_count
FROM main.delinquency_snapshot dl
JOIN main.loan_drawdown ld ON dl.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN main.credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN main.institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE dl.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND dl.principal_overdue_days >= 90
  AND ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY loan_count DESC;

SELECT 
    ld.loan_id AS 借据编号,
    p.display_name AS 借款方名称,
    pi.instruction_amount AS 指令金额,
    p2.display_name AS 收款方名称
FROM main.loan_drawdown ld
JOIN main.credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN main.party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN main.payment_instruction pi ON ld.loan_id = pi.loan_id
JOIN main.party p2 ON pi.intended_payee_party_id = p2.party_id
WHERE pi.payment_mode = 'ENTRUSTED_PAYMENT'
  AND pi.intended_payee_party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
ORDER BY pi.instruction_amount DESC
LIMIT 200;

SELECT 
    ca.agreement_id,
    p.display_name AS borrower_name,
    ca.contract_amount
FROM main.credit_agreement ca
JOIN main.party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
WHERE p.party_type = 'CORPORATE'
  AND p.status = 'FROZEN'
  AND ca.status = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY ca.contract_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    ld.loan_id AS 借据编号,
    lpc.product_name_zh AS 产品中文名称,
    ld.drawdown_type AS 投向行业,
    ld.disbursed_amount AS 放款金额
FROM main.loan_drawdown ld
JOIN main.loan_product_catalog lpc ON ld.drawdown_type = lpc.product_code
JOIN main.credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
WHERE lpc.product_family = 'WORKING_CAPITAL'
  AND ld.drawdown_type IN ('EXPORT_REFINANCE', 'PROJECT_FINANCE', 'HOUSEHOLD_MORTGAGE')  -- 此处根据实际投向行业字段调整
  AND ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND ca.status = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY ld.disbursed_amount DESC
LIMIT 200;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    ld.loan_id,
    lbs.principal_balance,
    avg_bal.avg_principal_balance,
    (lbs.principal_balance - avg_bal.avg_principal_balance) AS difference
FROM main.loan_drawdown ld
JOIN main.loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
JOIN main.credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN main.institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN (
    SELECT 
        ca.institution_id,
        AVG(lbs.principal_balance) AS avg_principal_balance
    FROM main.loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN main.credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    JOIN main.loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
    GROUP BY ca.institution_id
) avg_bal ON ca.institution_id = avg_bal.institution_id
WHERE lbs.principal_balance > 2 * avg_bal.avg_principal_balance
ORDER BY difference DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    SUM(CASE WHEN c.borrower_party_id NOT IN (
        SELECT DISTINCT pr.source_party_id
        FROM party_relation pr
        JOIN relation_type_catalog rtc ON pr.relation_type = rtc.relation_type
        WHERE rtc.relation_name_zh != '非关联方'
          AND pr.source_party_id IS NOT NULL
    ) THEN c.contract_amount ELSE 0 END) AS non_related_amount,
    SUM(c.contract_amount) AS total_amount,
    ROUND(1.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN c.borrower_party_id NOT IN (
        SELECT DISTINCT pr.source_party_id
        FROM party_relation pr
        JOIN relation_type_catalog rtc ON pr.relation_type = rtc.relation_type
        WHERE rtc.relation_name_zh != '非关联方'
          AND pr.source_party_id IS NOT NULL
    ) THEN c.contract_amount ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(c.contract_amount), 0), 4) AS related_ratio
FROM credit_agreement c
JOIN institution i ON c.institution_id = i.institution_id
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY related_ratio DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name AS 机构名称,
    p.display_name AS 客户名称,
    SUM(lbs.principal_balance) AS 余额合计,
    cs.net_capital AS 资本净额,
    ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance) * 1.0 / cs.net_capital * 100, 2) AS 占比
FROM main.loan_balance_snapshot lbs
JOIN main.loan_drawdown ld ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN main.credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN main.institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN main.party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN main.capital_snapshot cs ON ca.institution_id = cs.institution_id
WHERE lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND cs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY ca.institution_id, ca.borrower_party_id, i.institution_name, p.display_name, cs.net_capital
HAVING SUM(lbs.principal_balance) * 1.0 / cs.net_capital > 0.10
ORDER BY 占比 DESC
LIMIT 200;

SELECT 
    ca.agreement_id AS 授信合同编号,
    p.display_name AS 借款人名称,
    ca.annual_interest_rate AS 执行年利率,
    avg_rate.avg_interest_rate AS 所属目标行业平均利率,
    ROUND((ca.annual_interest_rate - avg_rate.avg_interest_rate) * 100.0 / avg_rate.avg_interest_rate, 2) AS 较行业平均上浮百分比
FROM main.credit_agreement ca
JOIN main.party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN (
    SELECT target_industry_code, AVG(annual_interest_rate) AS avg_interest_rate
    FROM main.credit_agreement
    WHERE status = 'ACTIVE'
      AND target_industry_code IS NOT NULL
      AND annual_interest_rate IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY target_industry_code
) avg_rate ON ca.target_industry_code = avg_rate.target_industry_code
WHERE ca.status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND ca.annual_interest_rate > avg_rate.avg_interest_rate * 1.1
ORDER BY 较行业平均上浮百分比 DESC, ca.agreement_id ASC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ca.borrower_party_id) AS over_limit_customer_count
FROM main.loan_drawdown ld
JOIN main.credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN main.institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN main.capital_snapshot cs ON i.institution_id = cs.institution_id
JOIN main.loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
WHERE ca.borrower_party_id IS NOT NULL
  AND lbs.principal_balance * 1.0 / cs.net_capital > 0.10
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY over_limit_customer_count DESC;

SELECT 
    eg.exposure_group_id AS 集团编号,
    eg.group_name AS 集团名称,
    SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) AS 余额合计,
    cs.net_capital AS 资本净额,
    ROUND(SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) * 1.0 / cs.net_capital * 100, 2) AS 占比
FROM main.exposure_group eg
JOIN main.exposure_group_member egm ON eg.exposure_group_id = egm.exposure_group_id
JOIN main.credit_agreement ca ON ca.borrower_party_id = egm.party_id
JOIN main.loan_drawdown ld ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN main.organization_unit ou ON ou.org_unit_id = ca.managing_org_unit_id
JOIN main.capital_snapshot cs ON cs.institution_id = ou.institution_id
WHERE eg.group_type = 'GROUP_CUSTOMER'
  AND ca.status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND ca.institution_id = ou.institution_id
GROUP BY eg.exposure_group_id, eg.group_name, cs.net_capital
HAVING SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) * 1.0 / cs.net_capital > 0.10
ORDER BY 占比 DESC;

SELECT 
    ca.agreement_id AS 授信合同编号,
    ca.maturity_on AS 合同到期日,
    ld.loan_id AS 未结清借据编号,
    ld.status AS 借据状态,
    ca.contract_amount AS 合同金额
FROM main.credit_agreement ca
JOIN main.loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
WHERE ca.status = 'MATURED'
  AND ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY ld.loan_id ASC;

SELECT 
    ld.loan_id AS 借据编号,
    ld.loan_account_id AS 发放账户编号,
    ld.disbursed_on AS 放款日期,
    pe.payment_id AS 转账流水号,
    pe.business_date AS 转账日期,
    pe.amount AS 转账金额,
    CAST(julianday(pe.business_date) - julianday(ld.disbursed_on) AS INTEGER) AS 放款至转出的间隔天数
FROM main.loan_drawdown ld
JOIN main.payment_event pe ON pe.from_account_id = ld.loan_account_id
WHERE pe.status = 'SETTLED'
  AND pe.business_date > ld.disbursed_on
  AND julianday(pe.business_date) - julianday(ld.disbursed_on) <= 7
ORDER BY 
    放款至转出的间隔天数 ASC,
    pe.amount DESC,
    ld.loan_id ASC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    p.display_name AS customer_name,
    ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance) * 1.0 / cs.net_capital, 4) AS exposure_ratio
FROM institution i
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
JOIN party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN capital_snapshot cs ON i.institution_id = cs.institution_id
JOIN party_type_catalog ptc ON p.party_type = ptc.party_type
WHERE ptc.name_zh = '对公客户'
  AND lbs.as_of_date = (SELECT MAX(as_of_date) FROM loan_balance_snapshot)
  AND cs.as_of_date = (SELECT MAX(as_of_date) FROM capital_snapshot)
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name, p.party_id, p.display_name, cs.net_capital
HAVING ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance) * 1.0 / cs.net_capital, 4) = (
    SELECT MAX(ratio)
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            i2.institution_id,
            p2.party_id,
            ROUND(SUM(lbs2.principal_balance) * 1.0 / cs2.net_capital, 4) AS ratio
        FROM institution i2
        JOIN credit_agreement ca2 ON i2.institution_id = ca2.institution_id
        JOIN loan_drawdown ld2 ON ca2.agreement_id = ld2.agreement_id
        JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs2 ON ld2.loan_id = lbs2.loan_id
        JOIN party p2 ON ca2.borrower_party_id = p2.party_id
        JOIN capital_snapshot cs2 ON i2.institution_id = cs2.institution_id
        JOIN party_type_catalog ptc2 ON p2.party_type = ptc2.party_type
        WHERE ptc2.name_zh = '对公客户'
          AND lbs2.as_of_date = (SELECT MAX(as_of_date) FROM loan_balance_snapshot)
          AND cs2.as_of_date = (SELECT MAX(as_of_date) FROM capital_snapshot)
        GROUP BY i2.institution_id, p2.party_id, cs2.net_capital
    ) t
    WHERE t.institution_id = i.institution_id
)
ORDER BY i.institution_name ASC;

SELECT
    ld.loan_id AS 借据编号,
    lbs.principal_balance AS 本金余额,
    NTILE(4) OVER (PARTITION BY ca.institution_id ORDER BY lbs.principal_balance DESC) AS 档位
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
ORDER BY 档位 ASC, 本金余额 DESC
LIMIT 300;

SELECT 
    ld.loan_id AS 借据编号,
    i.institution_name AS 机构名称,
    lbs.principal_balance AS 本金余额,
    ROUND(lbs.principal_balance * 100.0 / inst_total.total_principal, 2) AS 占比
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
JOIN (
    SELECT ca.institution_id, SUM(lbs.principal_balance) AS total_principal
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
    GROUP BY ca.institution_id
) inst_total ON ca.institution_id = inst_total.institution_id
WHERE lbs.as_of_date = (
    SELECT MAX(as_of_date) FROM loan_balance_snapshot WHERE loan_id = ld.loan_id
)
ORDER BY 
    i.institution_name ASC,
    占比 DESC,
    ld.loan_id ASC
LIMIT 300;

SELECT 
    ld.loan_id AS 借据编号,
    ld.disbursed_amount AS 累计放款金额,
    ld.status AS 借据状态,
    SUM(ds.overdue_principal) AS 逾期本金合计,
    COUNT(ds.delinquency_id) AS 逾期期次数
FROM main.loan_drawdown ld
JOIN main.delinquency_snapshot ds ON ld.loan_id = ds.loan_id
WHERE ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY ld.loan_id, ld.disbursed_amount, ld.status
HAVING COUNT(ds.delinquency_id) >= 2
ORDER BY 
    COUNT(ds.delinquency_id) DESC,
    SUM(ds.overdue_principal) DESC,
    ld.loan_id ASC;

SELECT 
    ld.disbursement_account_id AS 放款账户编号,
    ld.disbursed_on AS 放款日期,
    COUNT(*) AS 放款借据笔数
FROM main.loan_drawdown ld
GROUP BY ld.disbursement_account_id, ld.disbursed_on
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
ORDER BY 放款借据笔数 DESC
LIMIT 200;

SELECT DISTINCT ah.party_id AS customer_id
FROM main.account_holder ah
JOIN main.account a ON ah.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN main.term_deposit td ON a.account_id = td.account_id
JOIN main.credit_agreement ca ON ah.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
ORDER BY ah.party_id ASC;

SELECT sm.person_party_id AS 员工客户编号
FROM staff_member sm
WHERE sm.employment_status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND sm.person_party_id NOT IN (
      SELECT ah.party_id
      FROM account_holder ah
  )
ORDER BY sm.person_party_id ASC;

SELECT a.account_id
FROM main.account a
WHERE a.account_kind = 'SAVINGS'
  AND a.account_id NOT IN (
      SELECT DISTINCT pe.from_account_id
      FROM main.payment_event pe
      WHERE pe.payment_type = 'CASH_WITHDRAWAL'
        AND pe.status = 'SETTLED'
  )
ORDER BY a.account_id ASC
LIMIT 300;

SELECT security_id, guaranteed_amount
FROM main.guarantor_commitment
WHERE status = 'EXPIRED'
ORDER BY guaranteed_amount DESC;

SELECT 
  CASE 
    WHEN julianday('2026-06-30') - julianday(current_maturity_on) < 0 THEN '已到期'
    WHEN julianday('2026-06-30') - julianday(current_maturity_on) BETWEEN 0 AND 90 THEN '临期'
    ELSE '常态'
  END AS 档位,
  COUNT(*) AS 笔数
FROM main.loan_drawdown
GROUP BY 档位
ORDER BY 
  CASE 档位
    WHEN '常态' THEN 1
    WHEN '临期' THEN 2
    WHEN '已到期' THEN 3
  END;

SELECT cl.collateral_id, COUNT(DISTINCT cl.security_id) AS association_count
FROM main.collateral_link cl
JOIN main.security_agreement sa ON cl.security_id = sa.security_id
WHERE sa.status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND cl.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY cl.collateral_id
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT cl.security_id) > 1
ORDER BY association_count DESC;

SELECT 
    c.collateral_type,
    AVG(v.valuation_amount) AS avg_valuation_amount,
    COUNT(v.valuation_id) AS valuation_count
FROM collateral_asset c
JOIN collateral_valuation v ON c.collateral_id = v.collateral_id
WHERE v.appraiser_kind = 'BANK_INTERNAL'
GROUP BY c.collateral_type
ORDER BY avg_valuation_amount DESC;

SELECT
    ld.repayment_account_id AS 还款账户编号,
    ld.loan_id AS 借据编号,
    ld.disbursed_on AS 放款日期,
    ld.disbursed_amount AS 放款金额,
    cnt.cnt AS 该账户承接借据笔数
FROM main.loan_drawdown ld
JOIN (
    SELECT repayment_account_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM main.loan_drawdown
    GROUP BY repayment_account_id
    HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3
) cnt ON ld.repayment_account_id = cnt.repayment_account_id
WHERE ld.repayment_account_id IN (
    SELECT repayment_account_id
    FROM main.loan_drawdown
    GROUP BY repayment_account_id
    HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3
)
AND ld.loan_id IN (
    SELECT loan_id
    FROM (
        SELECT
            loan_id,
            repayment_account_id,
            disbursed_on,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY repayment_account_id ORDER BY disbursed_on ASC, loan_id ASC) AS rn
        FROM main.loan_drawdown
        WHERE repayment_account_id IN (
            SELECT repayment_account_id
            FROM main.loan_drawdown
            GROUP BY repayment_account_id
            HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3
        )
    ) ranked
    WHERE rn <= 2
)
ORDER BY ld.repayment_account_id ASC, ld.disbursed_on ASC;

SELECT 
    ca.agreement_id AS 授信合同编号,
    ca.contract_amount AS 合同金额,
    SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) AS 累计放款金额,
    SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) - ca.contract_amount AS 超合同投放金额,
    COUNT(ld.loan_id) AS 放款笔数
FROM main.credit_agreement ca
JOIN main.loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
GROUP BY ca.agreement_id, ca.contract_amount
HAVING SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) > ca.contract_amount
ORDER BY ca.agreement_id ASC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(a.account_id) AS account_count,
    SUM(ab.ledger_balance - ab.available_balance) AS total_difference
FROM account a
JOIN institution i ON a.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN account_balance_snapshot ab ON a.account_id = ab.account_id
WHERE ab.ledger_balance > ab.available_balance
  AND (ab.ledger_balance - ab.available_balance) > 5000000
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY total_difference DESC;

SELECT 
    t.account_id,
    t.opening_principal,
    t.maturity_on,
    t.annual_interest_rate
FROM main.term_deposit t
JOIN main.account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE t.maturity_on < '2026-06-30'
  AND a.status = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY t.maturity_on ASC;

SELECT card_id, card_type, issued_on
FROM main.payment_card
WHERE issued_on <= '2025-01-31'
  AND status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND card_type = 'DEBIT'
ORDER BY issued_on ASC, card_id ASC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    SUM(CASE WHEN ld.payment_mode = 'ENTRUSTED_PAYMENT' THEN ld.disbursed_amount ELSE 0 END) AS entrusted_amount,
    SUM(CASE WHEN ld.payment_mode = 'SELF_PAYMENT' THEN ld.disbursed_amount ELSE 0 END) AS self_payment_amount,
    ROUND(1.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN ld.payment_mode = 'ENTRUSTED_PAYMENT' THEN ld.disbursed_amount ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(ld.disbursed_amount), 0) * 100, 2) AS entrusted_ratio
FROM main.loan_drawdown ld
JOIN main.credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN main.institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING entrusted_ratio < 52
ORDER BY entrusted_ratio ASC, i.institution_name ASC;

SELECT 
    ca.agreement_id AS 授信合同编号,
    ld.loan_id AS 借据编号,
    ld.disbursed_amount AS 单笔放款金额,
    SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY ld.agreement_id) AS 合同内累计放款金额,
    ROUND(ld.disbursed_amount * 1.0 / SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY ld.agreement_id) * 100, 2) AS 单笔占比
FROM main.loan_drawdown ld
JOIN main.credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
WHERE ld.disbursed_amount * 1.0 / SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY ld.agreement_id) > 0.9
ORDER BY ca.agreement_id ASC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    SUM(wp.actual_raise_amount) AS actual_raise_total,
    SUM(CASE WHEN wp.status = 'ON_SALE' THEN wp.planned_raise_amount ELSE 0 END) AS planned_raise_total,
    ROUND(SUM(wp.actual_raise_amount) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN wp.status = 'ON_SALE' THEN wp.planned_raise_amount ELSE 0 END), 0), 4) AS completion_rate
FROM wealth_product wp
JOIN institution i ON wp.issuer_institution_id = i.institution_id
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING completion_rate > 1.2
ORDER BY completion_rate DESC;

SELECT 
    ld.borrower_party_id AS 借款人编号,
    p.display_name AS 借款人名称,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN rs.status = 'OVERDUE' THEN ld.loan_id END) AS 逾期借据笔数,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ld.loan_id) AS 全部借据笔数
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN party p ON ld.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
LEFT JOIN repayment_schedule rs ON ld.loan_id = rs.loan_id
WHERE ld.borrower_party_id IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY ld.borrower_party_id, p.display_name
HAVING 
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN rs.status = 'OVERDUE' THEN ld.loan_id END) > 0
    AND COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN rs.status = 'OVERDUE' THEN ld.loan_id END) < COUNT(DISTINCT ld.loan_id)
ORDER BY 
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN rs.status = 'OVERDUE' THEN ld.loan_id END) DESC,
    ld.borrower_party_id ASC;

SELECT 
    pi.instruction_id AS 支付指令编号,
    pi.loan_id AS 借据编号,
    p_borrower.display_name AS 借款人名称,
    p_payee.display_name AS 实际收款人名称,
    pi.instruction_amount AS 指令金额
FROM main.payment_instruction pi
JOIN main.loan_drawdown ld ON pi.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN main.credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN main.party p_borrower ON ca.borrower_party_id = p_borrower.party_id
JOIN main.party p_payee ON pi.intended_payee_party_id = p_payee.party_id
WHERE pi.status = 'EXECUTED'
  AND pi.intended_payee_party_id != ca.borrower_party_id
ORDER BY pi.instruction_amount DESC, pi.instruction_id ASC;

SELECT 
    ld.loan_id AS 借据编号,
    ld.disbursed_on AS 放款日期,
    ld.agreement_id AS 授信合同编号,
    ca.signed_on AS 合同签署日期,
    ld.disbursed_amount AS 放款金额
FROM main.loan_drawdown ld
JOIN main.credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
WHERE ld.disbursed_on < ca.signed_on
ORDER BY ld.loan_id ASC;

SELECT 
    ld.loan_id AS 借据编号,
    COUNT(rs.installment_id) AS 未结清期次数,
    ROUND(SUM(rs.principal_due), 2) AS 应还本金合计
FROM main.loan_drawdown ld
LEFT JOIN main.repayment_schedule rs ON ld.loan_id = rs.loan_id
WHERE ld.loan_id NOT IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT rs2.loan_id
    FROM main.repayment_schedule rs2
    WHERE rs2.status = 'PAID'
)
GROUP BY ld.loan_id
ORDER BY 应还本金合计 DESC, 借据编号 ASC
LIMIT 200;

SELECT 
    ld.loan_id AS 借据编号,
    ROUND(lbs.principal_balance, 2) AS 期末剩余本金,
    ROUND(lbs.overdue_principal, 2) AS 期末逾期本金
FROM main.loan_drawdown ld
JOIN main.loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
WHERE ld.status = 'WRITTEN_OFF'
  AND lbs.principal_balance > 10000000
ORDER BY lbs.principal_balance DESC, ld.loan_id ASC
LIMIT 200;

SELECT 
    ld.loan_id AS 借据编号,
    ld.disbursed_on AS 放款日期,
    ld.disbursement_account_id AS 发放账户编号,
    a.opened_on AS 账户开立日期
FROM main.loan_drawdown ld
JOIN main.account a ON ld.disbursement_account_id = a.account_id
WHERE ld.disbursed_on < a.opened_on
ORDER BY ld.disbursed_on ASC, ld.loan_id ASC;

SELECT 
    ld.loan_id AS 借据编号,
    ld.disbursement_account_id AS 发放账户编号,
    a.account_kind AS 账户类型,
    ld.disbursed_amount AS 放款金额
FROM main.loan_drawdown ld
JOIN main.account a ON ld.disbursement_account_id = a.account_id
WHERE a.account_kind = 'SAVINGS'
ORDER BY ld.disbursed_amount DESC, ld.loan_id ASC;

SELECT 
    ca.agreement_id AS 授信合同编号,
    ca.security_type AS 担保方式,
    ca.contract_amount AS 合同金额,
    p.display_name AS 借款人名称
FROM main.credit_agreement ca
JOIN main.party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
WHERE ca.security_type = 'CREDIT'
  AND ca.contract_amount > 8000000
ORDER BY ca.contract_amount DESC, ca.agreement_id ASC;

SELECT 
    p.display_name AS 借款人名称,
    p.party_id AS 客户编号,
    ca.annual_interest_rate AS 合同年利率,
    avg_rate.avg_annual_interest_rate AS 同机构同类产品平均年利率,
    (avg_rate.avg_annual_interest_rate - ca.annual_interest_rate) AS 利率价差
FROM main.credit_agreement ca
JOIN main.party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN (
    SELECT 
        institution_id,
        product_family,
        AVG(annual_interest_rate) AS avg_annual_interest_rate
    FROM main.credit_agreement
    GROUP BY institution_id, product_family
) avg_rate ON ca.institution_id = avg_rate.institution_id AND ca.product_family = avg_rate.product_family
WHERE ca.annual_interest_rate < avg_rate.avg_annual_interest_rate
  AND ca.borrower_party_id IN (
      SELECT DISTINCT egm.party_id
      FROM main.exposure_group_member egm
      JOIN main.exposure_group eg ON egm.exposure_group_id = eg.exposure_group_id
      WHERE eg.group_type != 'NON_RELATED'
  )
ORDER BY 利率价差 DESC;

SELECT 
    source_party_id AS 关联方甲方编号,
    target_party_id AS 关联方乙方编号,
    relation_type AS 关联关系名称
FROM main.party_relation
WHERE relation_type != 'NON_RELATED'
  AND source_party_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT borrower_party_id FROM main.credit_agreement)
  AND target_party_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT borrower_party_id FROM main.credit_agreement)
ORDER BY relation_type ASC, relation_id ASC;

SELECT 
    eg.group_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) AS member_count,
    SUM(lbs.principal_balance) AS total_balance,
    cs.net_capital,
    SUM(lbs.principal_balance) * 1.0 / cs.net_capital AS ratio
FROM exposure_group eg
JOIN exposure_group_member egm ON eg.exposure_group_id = egm.exposure_group_id
JOIN party p ON egm.party_id = p.party_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id 
    AND ca.institution_id = eg.institution_id
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN capital_snapshot cs ON cs.institution_id = eg.institution_id
WHERE egm.effective_to IS NULL
  AND ca.status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY eg.exposure_group_id, eg.group_name, cs.net_capital
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) >= 2
   AND (SUM(lbs.principal_balance) * 1.0 / cs.net_capital) > 0.1
ORDER BY ratio DESC
LIMIT 200;

SELECT 
    payer.display_name AS 付款方姓名,
    payee.display_name AS 收款方姓名,
    COUNT(pe.payment_id) AS 转账笔数,
    SUM(pe.amount) AS 转账金额合计
FROM main.payment_event pe
JOIN main.account_holder ah_from ON pe.from_account_id = ah_from.account_id
JOIN main.account_holder ah_to ON pe.to_account_id = ah_to.account_id
JOIN main.party payer ON ah_from.party_id = payer.party_id
JOIN main.party payee ON ah_to.party_id = payee.party_id
JOIN main.party_relation pr ON 
    (pr.source_party_id = ah_from.party_id AND pr.target_party_id = ah_to.party_id)
    OR 
    (pr.source_party_id = ah_to.party_id AND pr.target_party_id = ah_from.party_id)
WHERE pr.relation_type != 'NON_RELATED'
  AND pe.status = 'SETTLED'
GROUP BY payer.display_name, payee.display_name
ORDER BY 转账金额合计 DESC;

SELECT 
    wp.product_id,
    wp.product_name,
    ma.asset_name
FROM main.wealth_product wp
JOIN main.product_holding_snapshot phs ON wp.product_id = phs.product_id
JOIN main.managed_asset ma ON phs.asset_id = ma.asset_id
WHERE wp.risk_level = 'R5'
  AND wp.status = 'ON_SALE'
  AND phs.investment_path = 'NESTED_SPV'
ORDER BY wp.product_id ASC;

SELECT 
    ph.product_id,
    COUNT(ph.asset_id) AS asset_count
FROM main.product_holding_snapshot ph
WHERE ph.investment_path = 'NESTED_SPV'
   OR ph.investment_path = 'SPV'
GROUP BY ph.product_id
ORDER BY asset_count DESC
LIMIT 20;

SELECT 
    lb.loan_id AS 借据编号,
    lb.principal_balance AS 账面本金余额,
    MAX(d.principal_overdue_days) AS 最长逾期天数
FROM main.loan_balance_snapshot lb
JOIN main.delinquency_snapshot d ON lb.loan_id = d.loan_id
WHERE lb.principal_balance > 90000000
  AND lb.overdue_principal > 0
GROUP BY lb.loan_id, lb.principal_balance
HAVING MAX(d.principal_overdue_days) >= 200
ORDER BY 最长逾期天数 DESC, 借据编号 ASC;

SELECT 
    eg.exposure_group_id,
    eg.group_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ca.institution_id) AS involved_institution_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) AS member_count_with_credit
FROM exposure_group eg
JOIN exposure_group_member egm ON eg.exposure_group_id = egm.exposure_group_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.borrower_party_id = egm.party_id
WHERE egm.effective_to IS NULL
  AND ca.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY eg.exposure_group_id, eg.group_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ca.institution_id) >= 2
ORDER BY involved_institution_count DESC;

SELECT 
    eg.exposure_group_id,
    eg.group_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) AS overdue_member_count,
    COALESCE(SUM(lbs.overdue_principal), 0) AS total_overdue_principal
FROM main.exposure_group eg
JOIN main.exposure_group_member egm ON eg.exposure_group_id = egm.exposure_group_id
JOIN main.party p ON egm.party_id = p.party_id
JOIN main.credit_agreement ca ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN main.loan_drawdown ld ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN main.loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
WHERE lbs.overdue_principal > 0
GROUP BY eg.exposure_group_id, eg.group_name
ORDER BY total_overdue_principal DESC;

SELECT 
    p.display_name AS 企业名称,
    p.party_id AS 客户编号,
    COALESCE(SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount), 0) AS 对外担保合计,
    COALESCE(SUM(ca.contract_amount), 0) AS 自身借款合计,
    COALESCE(SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(ca.contract_amount), 0) AS 担保负债差额
FROM party p
JOIN organization_profile op ON p.party_id = op.party_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON p.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
JOIN guarantor_commitment gc ON p.party_id = gc.guarantor_party_id
JOIN security_agreement sa ON gc.security_id = sa.security_id
WHERE p.party_type = 'CORPORATE'
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name
HAVING COALESCE(SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount), 0) > COALESCE(SUM(ca.contract_amount), 0)
ORDER BY 担保负债差额 DESC;

SELECT 
    p.display_name AS 员工姓名,
    s.staff_id AS 员工编号,
    COUNT(ca.agreement_id) AS 授信合同笔数
FROM main.staff_member s
JOIN main.party p ON s.person_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN main.credit_agreement ca ON ca.borrower_party_id = s.person_party_id
WHERE s.employment_status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND s.departed_on IS NULL
GROUP BY p.display_name, s.staff_id
ORDER BY 授信合同笔数 DESC;

SELECT 
    p.display_name AS 借款人姓名,
    p.party_id AS 客户编号,
    SUM(lb.principal_balance) AS 本金余额合计,
    pp.annual_income AS 年收入,
    ROUND(SUM(lb.principal_balance) * 1.0 / pp.annual_income, 2) AS 倍数
FROM main.party p
JOIN main.person_profile pp ON p.party_id = pp.party_id
JOIN main.account_holder ah ON p.party_id = ah.party_id
JOIN main.account a ON ah.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN main.loan_drawdown ld ON a.account_id = ld.loan_account_id
JOIN main.loan_balance_snapshot lb ON ld.loan_id = lb.loan_id
WHERE p.party_type = 'INDIVIDUAL'
  AND a.account_kind = 'LOAN'
  AND a.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name, pp.annual_income
HAVING SUM(lb.principal_balance) * 1.0 / pp.annual_income > 2
ORDER BY 倍数 DESC
LIMIT 200;

SELECT 
    sp.display_name AS 员工姓名,
    so.operator_id AS 操作员编号,
    so.authority_level AS 权限级别,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ca.agreement_id) AS 自贷合同数
FROM main.staff_member sm
JOIN main.party sp ON sm.person_party_id = sp.party_id
JOIN main.service_operator so ON sm.staff_id = so.staff_id
JOIN main.credit_agreement ca ON ca.borrower_party_id = sp.party_id
WHERE so.operator_kind = 'CREDIT_OFFICER'
  AND ca.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY sp.display_name, so.operator_id, so.authority_level
ORDER BY 自贷合同数 DESC;

SELECT 
    p.display_name AS 员工姓名,
    ld.loan_id AS 借据编号,
    ld.disbursed_amount AS 放款金额,
    ld.disbursed_on AS 放款日期
FROM main.loan_drawdown ld
JOIN main.account a ON ld.disbursement_account_id = a.account_id
JOIN main.account_holder ah ON a.account_id = ah.account_id
JOIN main.party p ON ah.party_id = p.party_id
JOIN main.staff_member sm ON p.party_id = sm.person_party_id
WHERE p.party_type = 'STAFF'
  AND ah.holder_role = 'PRIMARY'
ORDER BY ld.disbursed_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    p.display_name AS 借款人姓名,
    p.party_id AS 借款人客户编号,
    pp.annual_income AS 个人年收入,
    ROUND(SUM(rs.principal_due + rs.interest_due), 2) AS 应还本息总额,
    ROUND(SUM(rs.principal_due + rs.interest_due) * 1.0 / pp.annual_income, 2) AS 占年收入倍数
FROM main.party p
JOIN main.person_profile pp ON p.party_id = pp.party_id
JOIN main.credit_agreement ca ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN main.loan_drawdown ld ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN main.repayment_schedule rs ON rs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
WHERE p.party_type = 'INDIVIDUAL'
  AND pp.annual_income > 0
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name, pp.annual_income
ORDER BY 占年收入倍数 DESC, p.party_id ASC
LIMIT 50;

SELECT 
    lpc.product_name_zh AS 产品类别名称,
    COUNT(rs.installment_id) AS 逾期期数,
    SUM(rs.principal_due) AS 逾期本金合计
FROM main.repayment_schedule rs
JOIN main.loan_drawdown ld ON rs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN main.credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN main.loan_product_catalog lpc ON ca.product_family = lpc.product_family
WHERE rs.status = 'OVERDUE'
GROUP BY lpc.product_name_zh
ORDER BY 逾期本金合计 DESC;

SELECT 
    ou.unit_name AS 机构名称,
    SUM(CASE WHEN td.maturity_on < '2026-06-30' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS 已过期笔数,
    SUM(CASE WHEN td.maturity_on >= '2026-06-30' 
              AND julianday(td.maturity_on) - julianday('2026-06-30') <= 90 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS 九十天内到期笔数,
    SUM(CASE WHEN julianday(td.maturity_on) - julianday('2026-06-30') > 90 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS 九十天以上到期笔数
FROM main.term_deposit td
JOIN main.account a ON td.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN main.organization_unit ou ON a.org_unit_id = ou.org_unit_id
GROUP BY ou.unit_name
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN td.maturity_on < '2026-06-30' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 20
ORDER BY 已过期笔数 DESC, 机构名称 ASC;

SELECT 
    ou.org_unit_id,
    ou.unit_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ah.account_id) AS joint_account_count
FROM main.organization_unit ou
LEFT JOIN main.account a ON ou.org_unit_id = a.org_unit_id
LEFT JOIN main.account_holder ah ON a.account_id = ah.account_id
WHERE ah.holder_role = 'SECONDARY'
GROUP BY ou.org_unit_id, ou.unit_name
ORDER BY joint_account_count DESC;

SELECT 
    ou.org_unit_id,
    ou.unit_name,
    COUNT(lbs.loan_id) AS overdue_count,
    SUM(lbs.overdue_principal) AS total_overdue_principal
FROM main.loan_balance_snapshot lbs
JOIN main.loan_drawdown ld ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN main.credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN main.organization_unit ou ON ca.managing_org_unit_id = ou.org_unit_id
WHERE lbs.overdue_principal > 0
GROUP BY ou.org_unit_id, ou.unit_name
ORDER BY total_overdue_principal DESC;

SELECT 
    loan_id,
    COUNT(*) AS overdue_installment_count,
    SUM(principal_due) AS total_overdue_principal
FROM main.repayment_schedule
WHERE status = 'OVERDUE'
GROUP BY loan_id
HAVING SUM(principal_due) > 120000000
ORDER BY total_overdue_principal DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(rs.installment_id) AS overdue_count,
    SUM(rs.interest_due) AS total_interest_due
FROM main.repayment_schedule rs
JOIN main.loan_drawdown ld ON rs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN main.credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN main.institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE rs.status = 'OVERDUE'
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING COUNT(rs.installment_id) >= 30
ORDER BY overdue_count DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT r.loan_id) AS overdue_loan_count
FROM main.institution i
JOIN main.loan_drawdown ld ON i.institution_id = ld.agreement_id  -- placeholder, will fix below
JOIN main.repayment_schedule r ON ld.loan_id = r.loan_id
WHERE r.status = 'OVERDUE'
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT r.loan_id) >= 240
ORDER BY overdue_loan_count DESC;

SELECT 
    loan_id,
    installment_no,
    principal_due,
    interest_due
FROM main.repayment_schedule
WHERE status = 'OVERDUE'
  AND principal_due > 90000000
ORDER BY principal_due DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    SUM(cf.limit_amount) AS total_credit_limit,
    SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) AS total_disbursed_amount,
    cs.net_capital,
    ROUND(SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) * 1.0 / cs.net_capital, 4) AS disbursed_to_capital_ratio
FROM main.institution i
LEFT JOIN main.credit_facility cf ON i.institution_id = cf.institution_id
LEFT JOIN main.credit_agreement ca ON cf.facility_id = ca.facility_id
LEFT JOIN main.loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
LEFT JOIN main.capital_snapshot cs ON i.institution_id = cs.institution_id
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name, cs.net_capital
HAVING SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) > cs.net_capital
ORDER BY disbursed_to_capital_ratio DESC;

SELECT 
    sa.security_id AS 担保合同编号,
    sa.secured_amount AS 设定担保金额,
    COUNT(gc.commitment_id) AS 保证人个数,
    COALESCE(SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount), 0) AS 保证金额合计
FROM main.security_agreement sa
LEFT JOIN main.guarantor_commitment gc 
    ON sa.security_id = gc.security_id 
    AND gc.status = 'ACTIVE'
WHERE sa.security_type = 'GUARANTEE'
    AND sa.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY sa.security_id, sa.secured_amount
HAVING COALESCE(SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount), 0) < sa.secured_amount
ORDER BY 保证金额合计 DESC;

SELECT 
    f.facility_id AS 授信额度编号,
    f.limit_amount AS 授信限额,
    s.name_zh AS 额度状态名称
FROM main.credit_facility f
JOIN main.status_catalog s 
    ON f.status = s.status_code 
    AND s.entity = 'credit_agreement'
WHERE f.facility_type = 'ACCEPTANCE'
ORDER BY f.limit_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    cf.facility_type AS 授信类型代码,
    SUM(cf.limit_amount) AS 授信限额合计
FROM main.credit_facility cf
JOIN main.institution i ON cf.institution_id = i.institution_id
GROUP BY i.institution_name, cf.facility_type
HAVING SUM(cf.limit_amount) > 2000000000
ORDER BY SUM(cf.limit_amount) DESC;

SELECT facility_type, COUNT(*) AS record_count
FROM main.credit_facility
WHERE limit_amount > 300000000
GROUP BY facility_type
ORDER BY record_count DESC;

SELECT 
    pmc.payment_mode_name_zh AS 支付方式中文名称,
    COUNT(ld.loan_id) AS 记录数
FROM main.loan_drawdown ld
LEFT JOIN main.payment_mode_catalog pmc ON ld.payment_mode = pmc.payment_mode
GROUP BY pmc.payment_mode_name_zh
ORDER BY 记录数 DESC;

WITH ranked_products AS (
    SELECT 
        product_id,
        actual_raise_amount,
        minimum_holding_days,
        NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY actual_raise_amount DESC) AS quartile_group
    FROM wealth_product
    WHERE status = 'ON_SALE'
),
grouped AS (
    SELECT 
        quartile_group,
        COUNT(*) AS product_count
    FROM ranked_products
    WHERE minimum_holding_days > 0
    GROUP BY quartile_group
)
SELECT 
    quartile_group AS group_no,
    product_count
FROM grouped
WHERE product_count BETWEEN 31 AND 33
ORDER BY quartile_group ASC;

SELECT 
    SUM(cf.limit_amount) AS 循环授信限额合计,
    COUNT(ld.loan_id) AS 发放笔数
FROM main.credit_facility cf
JOIN main.credit_agreement ca ON cf.facility_id = ca.facility_id
JOIN main.loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
WHERE cf.facility_type = 'REVOLVING' 
  AND ld.payment_mode = 'ENTRUSTED_PAYMENT'
GROUP BY cf.facility_id
ORDER BY 循环授信限额合计 DESC;

SELECT 
    pmc.payment_mode_name_zh AS 支付方式中文名称,
    COUNT(pi.instruction_id) AS 待执行指令数量
FROM main.payment_instruction pi
JOIN main.payment_mode_catalog pmc ON pi.payment_mode = pmc.payment_mode
WHERE pi.status = 'PENDING'
GROUP BY pi.payment_mode, pmc.payment_mode_name_zh
ORDER BY 待执行指令数量 DESC;

SELECT 
    itc.name_zh AS instrument_type_name_zh,
    sc.name_zh AS status_name_zh
FROM main.instrument_type_catalog itc
CROSS JOIN main.status_catalog sc
WHERE sc.entity = 'loan_drawdown'
ORDER BY itc.name_zh, sc.name_zh;

SELECT 
    ou.org_unit_id,
    ou.unit_name,
    COUNT(sa.staff_id) AS credit_officer_count
FROM main.organization_unit ou
LEFT JOIN main.staff_assignment sa 
    ON ou.org_unit_id = sa.org_unit_id
    AND sa.role_code = 'CREDIT_OFFICER'
GROUP BY ou.org_unit_id, ou.unit_name
ORDER BY credit_officer_count DESC;

SELECT 
    d.loan_id AS 借据编号,
    c.grade_name_zh AS 五级分类名称,
    d.principal_overdue_days AS 本金逾期天数,
    d.overdue_principal AS 逾期本金
FROM delinquency_snapshot d
JOIN risk_classification r ON d.loan_id = r.loan_id
JOIN classification_grade c ON r.grade_code = c.grade_code
WHERE d.principal_overdue_days > 30
  AND c.grade_code = 'NORMAL'
ORDER BY d.principal_overdue_days DESC, d.loan_id ASC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(*) AS insufficient_provision_count
FROM main.loan_drawdown ld
JOIN main.credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN main.institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN main.provision_snapshot ps ON ld.loan_id = ps.loan_id
WHERE ps.provision_stage = 'STAGE_2'
  AND ps.required_amount > 0
  AND ps.recognized_amount * 1.0 / ps.required_amount < 0.5
GROUP BY i.institution_name
ORDER BY insufficient_provision_count DESC, i.institution_name ASC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    SUM(p.required_amount - p.recognized_amount) AS provision_gap_total
FROM main.provision_snapshot p
JOIN main.loan_drawdown ld ON p.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN main.credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN main.institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE p.required_amount > p.recognized_amount
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY provision_gap_total DESC, i.institution_name ASC;

SELECT 
    a.account_id,
    a.account_subtype,
    b.ledger_balance
FROM main.account a
LEFT JOIN main.account_balance_snapshot b ON a.account_id = b.account_id
LEFT JOIN main.account_holder h ON a.account_id = h.account_id AND h.holder_role = 'SECONDARY'
WHERE a.status = 'DORMANT'
  AND a.account_kind = 'SAVINGS'
  AND h.account_holder_id IS NULL
ORDER BY b.ledger_balance DESC;

SELECT 
    p.customer_segment,
    COUNT(*) AS customer_count
FROM main.person_profile pp
JOIN main.party p ON pp.party_id = p.party_id
WHERE pp.annual_income > 1000000
  AND p.party_type = 'INDIVIDUAL'
GROUP BY p.customer_segment
ORDER BY customer_count DESC, p.customer_segment ASC;

SELECT asset_category_primary, COUNT(*) AS asset_count
FROM main.managed_asset
WHERE industry_code IN (
    SELECT sector_code
    FROM main.industry_sector
    WHERE risk_category = 'RESTRICTED'
)
GROUP BY asset_category_primary
HAVING COUNT(*) < 33
ORDER BY asset_count DESC, asset_category_primary ASC;

SELECT 
    p.party_id AS 客户编号,
    pp.annual_income AS 年收入,
    SUM(cf.limit_amount) AS 授信额度合计,
    ROUND(SUM(cf.limit_amount) * 1.0 / pp.annual_income, 2) AS 偿债比
FROM party p
JOIN person_profile pp ON p.party_id = pp.party_id
JOIN credit_facility cf ON p.party_id = cf.obligor_party_id
WHERE p.party_type = 'INDIVIDUAL'
GROUP BY p.party_id, pp.annual_income
HAVING SUM(cf.limit_amount) * 1.0 / pp.annual_income > 3
ORDER BY 偿债比 DESC, p.party_id ASC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT 
    occupation_code,
    employment_sector,
    COUNT(*) AS customer_count
FROM main.person_profile
GROUP BY occupation_code, employment_sector
ORDER BY customer_count DESC, occupation_code ASC, employment_sector ASC;

SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS card_count
FROM main.payment_card
WHERE card_type = 'DEBIT'
GROUP BY status
ORDER BY card_count DESC, status ASC;

SELECT 
    ou.org_unit_id,
    ou.unit_name,
    COUNT(pe.payment_id) AS transaction_count,
    ROUND(SUM(pe.amount), 2) AS total_amount
FROM payment_card pc
JOIN account a ON pc.settlement_account_id = a.account_id
JOIN payment_event pe ON pe.from_account_id = a.account_id
JOIN party p ON pc.holder_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN organization_unit ou ON p.home_org_unit_id = ou.org_unit_id
JOIN card_type_catalog ctc ON pc.card_type = ctc.card_type
WHERE ctc.name_zh = '贷记卡'
  AND pe.is_cash = 1
GROUP BY ou.org_unit_id, ou.unit_name
ORDER BY total_amount DESC, ou.unit_name ASC;

SELECT 
    pe.payment_id AS 交易编号,
    pc.card_id AS 银行卡编号,
    pc.holder_party_id AS 持卡人编号,
    pe.business_date AS 交易日期,
    pe.amount AS 交易金额
FROM payment_event pe
JOIN payment_card pc ON pe.from_account_id = pc.settlement_account_id
JOIN card_type_catalog ctc ON pc.card_type = ctc.card_type
WHERE ctc.card_type = 'CREDIT'
  AND pe.is_cash = 1
ORDER BY pe.amount DESC, pe.payment_id ASC, pc.card_id ASC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT 
    pc.holder_party_id AS 持卡人编号,
    COUNT(pe.payment_id) AS 现金交易笔数,
    ROUND(SUM(pe.amount), 2) AS 金额合计
FROM payment_card pc
JOIN payment_event pe ON pc.settlement_account_id = pe.from_account_id
WHERE pc.card_type = 'CREDIT' 
  AND pe.payment_type IN ('CASH_WITHDRAWAL', 'CASH_DEPOSIT')
  AND pe.is_cash = 1
GROUP BY pc.holder_party_id
HAVING COUNT(pe.payment_id) > 5
ORDER BY 现金交易笔数 DESC, 金额合计 DESC;

SELECT holder_party_id, COUNT(*) AS card_count
FROM main.payment_card
GROUP BY holder_party_id
HAVING COUNT(*) > 3
ORDER BY card_count DESC, holder_party_id ASC;

SELECT 
  c.name_zh AS 银行卡类型名称,
  COUNT(p.payment_id) AS 交易笔数,
  ROUND(SUM(p.amount) * 1.0 / COUNT(p.payment_id), 2) AS 平均单笔金额
FROM main.payment_event p
JOIN main.payment_card pc ON p.from_account_id = pc.settlement_account_id
JOIN main.card_type_catalog c ON pc.card_type = c.card_type
WHERE p.is_cash = 1
  AND p.status = 'SETTLED'
GROUP BY c.card_type, c.name_zh
ORDER BY 平均单笔金额 DESC, 银行卡类型名称 ASC;

SELECT 
  payment_type AS 交易渠道,
  COUNT(*) AS 交易数量,
  AVG(amount) AS 平均金额
FROM main.payment_event
WHERE status = 'SETTLED' 
  AND is_cash = 0
GROUP BY payment_type
HAVING AVG(amount) > 11780000
ORDER BY AVG(amount) DESC, payment_type ASC;

SELECT 
    t.account_id,
    t.maturity_on,
    a.status
FROM main.term_deposit t
JOIN main.account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE t.maturity_on < '2026-06-30'
  AND a.status = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY t.maturity_on DESC
LIMIT 200;

SELECT 
    c.collateral_id,
    c.asset_label,
    MAX(v.valuation_amount) AS highest_valuation
FROM main.collateral_asset c
JOIN main.collateral_valuation v ON c.collateral_id = v.collateral_id
GROUP BY c.collateral_id, c.asset_label
HAVING COUNT(v.valuation_id) >= 2
ORDER BY highest_valuation DESC;

SELECT 
    cl.collateral_id AS 押品编号,
    ca.asset_label AS 押品标识,
    COUNT(*) AS 押品被引用的次数,
    COUNT(DISTINCT cl.security_id) AS 关联的不同担保合同数
FROM main.collateral_link cl
JOIN main.collateral_asset ca ON cl.collateral_id = ca.collateral_id
WHERE cl.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY cl.collateral_id, ca.asset_label
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
ORDER BY 押品被引用的次数 DESC, 押品编号 ASC;

SELECT 
    g.guarantor_party_id AS 保证人客户编号,
    p.display_name AS 保证人名称,
    ca.agreement_id AS 授信合同编号,
    ROUND(g.guaranteed_amount, 2) AS 保证承诺金额,
    ROUND(ld.total_disbursed, 2) AS 实际放款总金额
FROM guarantor_commitment g
JOIN secured_obligation so ON g.security_id = so.security_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON so.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN party p ON g.guarantor_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN (
    SELECT agreement_id, SUM(disbursed_amount) AS total_disbursed
    FROM loan_drawdown
    GROUP BY agreement_id
) ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
WHERE g.status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND g.guaranteed_amount > ld.total_disbursed
ORDER BY g.guaranteed_amount DESC, g.guarantor_party_id ASC, ca.agreement_id ASC;

SELECT 
    ca.agreement_id,
    ca.borrower_party_id,
    ca.contract_amount,
    COALESCE(SUM(so.covered_amount), 0) AS total_covered,
    ca.contract_amount - COALESCE(SUM(so.covered_amount), 0) AS coverage_gap
FROM main.credit_agreement ca
LEFT JOIN main.secured_obligation so ON ca.agreement_id = so.agreement_id
LEFT JOIN main.security_agreement sa ON so.security_id = sa.security_id
WHERE ca.status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND sa.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY ca.agreement_id, ca.borrower_party_id, ca.contract_amount
HAVING ca.contract_amount > COALESCE(SUM(so.covered_amount), 0)
ORDER BY coverage_gap DESC, ca.agreement_id ASC
LIMIT 100;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    cg.grade_name_zh,
    COUNT(*) AS insufficient_provision_count
FROM main.loan_drawdown ld
JOIN main.risk_classification rc ON ld.loan_id = rc.loan_id
JOIN main.classification_grade cg ON rc.grade_code = cg.grade_code
JOIN main.credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN main.institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN main.provision_snapshot ps ON ld.loan_id = ps.loan_id
WHERE cg.grade_code = 'SUBSTANDARD'
  AND cg.is_nonperforming = 1
  AND ps.recognized_amount < ps.required_amount
GROUP BY i.institution_name, cg.grade_name_zh
ORDER BY insufficient_provision_count DESC, i.institution_name ASC;

SELECT 
    ca.borrower_party_id AS 债务人编号,
    ld.loan_id AS 借据编号,
    lb.principal_balance AS 贷款余额,
    ca.contract_amount AS 授信金额,
    ROUND(lb.principal_balance * 1.0 / ca.contract_amount, 2) AS 余额倍数
FROM main.loan_drawdown ld
JOIN main.credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN main.loan_balance_snapshot lb ON ld.loan_id = lb.loan_id
WHERE lb.principal_balance * 1.0 / ca.contract_amount >= 4
ORDER BY 余额倍数 DESC, ld.loan_id ASC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    cg.grade_name_zh,
    COUNT(*) AS over_provision_count,
    SUM(ps.recognized_amount - ps.required_amount) AS over_provision_amount
FROM main.provision_snapshot ps
JOIN main.loan_drawdown ld ON ps.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN main.credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN main.institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN main.risk_classification rc ON ps.loan_id = rc.loan_id
JOIN main.classification_grade cg ON rc.grade_code = cg.grade_code
WHERE cg.is_nonperforming = 1
  AND ps.recognized_amount > ps.required_amount
GROUP BY i.institution_name, cg.grade_name_zh
ORDER BY over_provision_amount DESC, i.institution_name ASC, cg.grade_name_zh ASC;

SELECT
    c.collateral_id,
    c.asset_label,
    ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN v.valuation_type = 'INTERNAL' THEN v.valuation_amount END), 2) AS internal_max_value,
    ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN v.valuation_type = 'EXTERNAL' THEN v.valuation_amount END), 2) AS external_max_value,
    ROUND(
        MAX(CASE WHEN v.valuation_type = 'INTERNAL' THEN v.valuation_amount END) -
        MAX(CASE WHEN v.valuation_type = 'EXTERNAL' THEN v.valuation_amount END),
        2
    ) AS undervaluation_gap
FROM main.collateral_asset c
JOIN main.collateral_valuation v ON c.collateral_id = v.collateral_id
WHERE v.valuation_type IN ('INTERNAL', 'EXTERNAL')
GROUP BY c.collateral_id, c.asset_label
HAVING internal_max_value IS NOT NULL
   AND external_max_value IS NOT NULL
   AND internal_max_value > external_max_value
ORDER BY undervaluation_gap DESC;

SELECT
    c.collateral_id AS 抵质押物编号,
    c.asset_label AS 资产名称,
    ROUND(latest_val.latest_valuation, 2) AS 最新评估价,
    ROUND(COALESCE(link_sum.total_pledged, 0), 2) AS 累计质押额,
    ROUND(COALESCE(link_sum.total_pledged, 0) - latest_val.latest_valuation, 2) AS 覆盖缺口
FROM main.collateral_asset c
JOIN (
    SELECT collateral_id, valuation_amount AS latest_valuation
    FROM main.collateral_valuation cv
    WHERE valued_on = (
        SELECT MAX(valued_on)
        FROM main.collateral_valuation cv2
        WHERE cv2.collateral_id = cv.collateral_id
    )
) latest_val ON c.collateral_id = latest_val.collateral_id
JOIN (
    SELECT collateral_id, SUM(pledged_amount) AS total_pledged
    FROM main.collateral_link
    WHERE status = 'ACTIVE'
    GROUP BY collateral_id
) link_sum ON c.collateral_id = link_sum.collateral_id
WHERE COALESCE(link_sum.total_pledged, 0) > latest_val.latest_valuation
ORDER BY 覆盖缺口 DESC;

SELECT 
    g.guarantor_party_id AS 保证人编号,
    p.display_name AS 保证人名称,
    ROUND(SUM(DISTINCT ca.contract_amount), 2) AS 自身借款金额合计,
    ROUND(SUM(DISTINCT gc.guaranteed_amount), 2) AS 对外保证金额合计
FROM main.guarantor_commitment gc
JOIN main.party p ON gc.guarantor_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN main.credit_agreement ca ON gc.guarantor_party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
WHERE gc.status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND ca.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY gc.guarantor_party_id, p.display_name
HAVING SUM(DISTINCT gc.guaranteed_amount) > SUM(DISTINCT ca.contract_amount)
ORDER BY 对外保证金额合计 DESC;

SELECT 
    sa.security_id AS 担保合同编号,
    ROUND(sa.secured_amount, 2) AS 担保债权金额,
    COUNT(gc.commitment_id) AS 保证人数量,
    ROUND(SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount), 2) AS 保证承诺金额合计
FROM main.security_agreement sa
LEFT JOIN main.guarantor_commitment gc 
    ON sa.security_id = gc.security_id 
    AND gc.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY sa.security_id, sa.secured_amount
HAVING SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount) < sa.secured_amount
ORDER BY SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount) DESC;

SELECT p.customer_segment, COUNT(*) AS customer_count
FROM person_profile pp
JOIN party p ON pp.party_id = p.party_id
WHERE pp.is_public_official = 1
  AND pp.annual_income >= 300000
  AND p.party_type = 'INDIVIDUAL'
GROUP BY p.customer_segment
ORDER BY customer_count DESC, p.customer_segment ASC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    egt.name_zh AS exposure_group_type_name_zh,
    COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) AS member_count
FROM main.institution i
JOIN main.exposure_group eg ON i.institution_id = eg.institution_id
JOIN main.exposure_group_type_catalog egt ON eg.group_type = egt.group_type
JOIN main.exposure_group_member egm ON eg.exposure_group_id = egm.exposure_group_id
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name, eg.group_type, egt.name_zh
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) >= 6
ORDER BY member_count DESC;

SELECT 
    egm.party_id AS member_customer_id,
    p.display_name AS customer_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT egm.exposure_group_id) AS group_count
FROM main.exposure_group_member egm
JOIN main.party p ON egm.party_id = p.party_id
GROUP BY egm.party_id, p.display_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT egm.exposure_group_id) >= 2
ORDER BY group_count DESC, member_customer_id ASC;

SELECT 
    p.party_id AS 主体编号,
    p.display_name AS 主体名称,
    COUNT(DISTINCT pr.relation_id) AS 关联关系条数,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ca.agreement_id) AS 借款合同笔数
FROM main.party p
LEFT JOIN main.party_relation pr 
    ON (pr.source_party_id = p.party_id OR pr.target_party_id = p.party_id)
    AND pr.relation_type != 'NON_RELATED'
LEFT JOIN main.credit_agreement ca 
    ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
WHERE p.party_type = 'CORPORATE'
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 
      FROM main.party_relation pr2 
      WHERE (pr2.source_party_id = p.party_id OR pr2.target_party_id = p.party_id)
        AND pr2.relation_type != 'NON_RELATED'
  )
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 
      FROM main.credit_agreement ca2 
      WHERE ca2.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
  )
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name
ORDER BY 关联关系条数 DESC;

SELECT 
    p.party_id AS 客户编号,
    p.display_name AS 客户名称,
    COUNT(DISTINCT egm.exposure_group_id) AS 所属集团数量
FROM party p
JOIN party_relation pr ON p.party_id = pr.source_party_id
JOIN relation_type_catalog rtc ON pr.relation_type = rtc.relation_type
JOIN exposure_group_member egm ON p.party_id = egm.party_id
WHERE rtc.relation_name_zh = '影子股东'
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name
ORDER BY 所属集团数量 DESC, p.party_id ASC;

SELECT 
    pr.relation_id,
    pr.source_party_id,
    pr.target_party_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ca1.agreement_id) AS source_contract_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ca2.agreement_id) AS target_contract_count
FROM party_relation pr
LEFT JOIN credit_agreement ca1 
    ON pr.source_party_id = ca1.borrower_party_id
LEFT JOIN credit_agreement ca2 
    ON pr.target_party_id = ca2.borrower_party_id
WHERE pr.relation_type != 'NON_RELATED'
GROUP BY pr.relation_id, pr.source_party_id, pr.target_party_id
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ca1.agreement_id) > 0 
   AND COUNT(DISTINCT ca2.agreement_id) > 0
ORDER BY (COUNT(DISTINCT ca1.agreement_id) + COUNT(DISTINCT ca2.agreement_id)) DESC;

SELECT collateral_id, asset_label, collateral_type
FROM main.collateral_asset
WHERE status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM main.collateral_link
    WHERE collateral_link.collateral_id = collateral_asset.collateral_id
      AND collateral_link.status = 'ACTIVE'
  )
ORDER BY collateral_id ASC;

SELECT
    g.guarantor_party_id AS 保证人编号,
    p.display_name AS 保证人名称,
    ROUND(SUM(g.guaranteed_amount), 2) AS 有效保证责任合计,
    ROUND(COALESCE(loan_bal.self_loan_balance, 0), 2) AS 自身贷款金额,
    ROUND(SUM(g.guaranteed_amount) - COALESCE(loan_bal.self_loan_balance, 0), 2) AS 超额担保金额
FROM main.guarantor_commitment g
JOIN main.party p ON g.guarantor_party_id = p.party_id
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        ld.agreement_id,
        ca.borrower_party_id,
        SUM(lbs.principal_balance) AS self_loan_balance
    FROM main.loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN main.loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
    JOIN main.credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    WHERE ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
    GROUP BY ca.borrower_party_id
